title: Turkey Sausage Egg Muffins
seoTitle: Turkey Sausage Egg Muffins | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Grab-and-go protein cups with spinach and bell pepper for shift breakfast
subtitle: Grab-and-go protein cups with spinach and bell pepper for shift breakfast
description: Lean turkey sausage browns with spinach and diced bell pepper, then bakes in muffin tins with eggs and a touch of cheddar for portable morning protein.

steps.title: Preheat and brown sausage
steps.instruction: Heat oven to 375°F. Cook turkey sausage in a skillet over medium heat 8–10 minutes, crumbling until fully browned and no pink remains.

steps.title: Wilt spinach and soften pepper
steps.instruction: Add onion, bell pepper, and garlic to the skillet. Cook 4 minutes until softened. Stir in spinach until wilted and moisture mostly evaporates.

steps.title: Whisk egg base
steps.instruction: Whisk whole eggs, egg whites, salt, and pepper in a large bowl until frothy and uniform in color with no streaks of yolk.

steps.title: Fill muffin cups
steps.instruction: Divide sausage-vegetable mix among 24 greased muffin cups. Top each with shredded cheddar. Pour egg mixture evenly until cups are ¾ full.

steps.title: Bake until set
steps.instruction: Bake 20–24 minutes until centers are puffed and firm to the touch, not jiggly. A knife inserted in center should come out clean.

proTips: Cool muffins on a rack so bottoms do not steam soggy in the tin.
Add hot sauce to the egg mix for crews who want morning heat without extra dishes.
Freeze individually wrapped; thaw overnight in the walk-in for backup breakfasts.
tonightSpread: Fresh fruit platter and coffee for a full morning line.
Whole-grain English muffins for crew who want a bread base.
leftovers: Crumble muffins into a breakfast burrito with salsa.
Chop and toss into a hash with diced potatoes and hot sauce.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Hands-free breakfast that survives a delayed alarm. Each muffin packs protein without the grease of traditional breakfast sandwiches.
mealPrepNotes: Bake Sunday for Monday shift. Cool completely before storing in labeled containers. Reheat 45 seconds per muffin. Station: Use two 12-cup muffin tins or one 24-cup commercial tin for even batch timing. Station: Spray tins generously—egg sticks badly on rushed cleanup nights. Station: Line a sheet pan under tins to catch overflow and protect the oven floor.
